gizmo.title: Itshati ye-radar
gizmo.description: Itshati ye-radar (yesigcawu) yeemodeli zokuvuthwa nokumaka iinkalo, njenge-HEOSAT. Ibandakanya isicatshulwa esingenye indlela netheyibhile yedatha.

configure.title: Isihloko
configure.description: Isihloko setshati; sikwasetyenziswa njengegama layo elifikelelekayo.

configure.title: Iindidi
configure.description: Udidi olunye kumgca ngamnye. Kufuneka ubuncinane ezi-3.

configure.title: Amanqaku
configure.description: Amanani ahlulwe ngeekoma, elinye kudidi ngalunye ngolandelelwano olufanayo.

configure.title: Amanqaku ekujoliswe kuwo
configure.description: Amanani ahlulwe ngeekoma, elinye kudidi ngalunye ngolandelelwano olufanayo.

configure.title: Bonisa isitshixo
configure.description: Bonisa isitshixo esibiza amanqaku nezinto ekujoliswe kuzo.

configure.title: Imfutshane
configure.description: Itshati encinci engenazo iilebhile, isitshixo okanye itheyibhile yedatha. Hambisa imowusi phezu kwenqaku ukubona amaxabiso alo.

advanced.title: Ilebhile yokujolisa
advanced.description: Ilebhile yesitshixo netheyibhile yezinto ekujoliswe kuzo.
